verses.original: אָ֖ז אָמַ֣ר שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה יְהוָ֣ה אָמַ֔ר לִשְׁכּ֖וֹן בָּעֲרָפֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz ’ā·mar šə·lō·mōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar liš·kō·wn bā·‘ă·rā·p̄el
verses.literal: Then Solomon declared The LORD has said that He would dwell in the thick cloud

verses.original: וַֽאֲנִ֛י בָּנִ֥יתִי בֵית־ זְבֻ֖ל לָ֑ךְ וּמָכ֥וֹן לְשִׁבְתְּךָ֖ עוֹלָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî bā·nî·ṯî ḇêṯ- zə·ḇul lāḵ ū·mā·ḵō·wn lə·šiḇ·tə·ḵā ‘ō·w·lā·mîm
verses.literal: But I have built You an exalted house a place for You to dwell forever

verses.original: וַיַּסֵּ֤ב הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ אֶת־ פָּנָ֔יו וַיְבָ֕רֶךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל־ קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְכָל־ קְהַ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עוֹמֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yas·sêḇ ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- pā·nāw way·ḇā·reḵ ’êṯ kāl- qə·hal yiś·rā·’êl wə·ḵāl qə·hal yiś·rā·’êl ‘ō·w·mêḏ
verses.literal: And as the whole assembly of Israel stood there the king - turned around and blessed them all . . . . . .

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר בְּפִ֔יו אֵ֖ת דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑י וּבְיָדָ֥יו מִלֵּ֖א לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer bā·rūḵ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer dib·ber bə·p̄îw ’êṯ dā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇî ū·ḇə·yā·ḏāw mil·lê lê·mōr
verses.literal: and said Blessed be the LORD the God of Israel who has fulfilled with His own hand what He spoke with His mouth to my father David saying

verses.original: מִן־ הַיּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֣אתִי אֶת־ עַמִּי֮ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ לֹא־ בָחַ֣רְתִּֽי בְעִ֗יר מִכֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִבְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לִהְי֥וֹת שְׁמִ֖י שָׁ֑ם וְלֹא־ בָחַ֣רְתִּֽי בְאִ֔ישׁ לִהְי֥וֹת נָגִ֖יד עַל־ עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: min- hay·yō·wm ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣê·ṯî ’eṯ- ‘am·mî mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim lō- ḇā·ḥar·tî ḇə·‘îr mik·kōl šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl liḇ·nō·wṯ ba·yiṯ lih·yō·wṯ šə·mî šām wə·lō- ḇā·ḥar·tî ḇə·’îš lih·yō·wṯ nā·ḡîḏ ‘al- ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Since the day I brought My people out of the land of Egypt I have not chosen a city from any tribe of Israel in which to build a house so that My Name would be there nor have I chosen anyone to be ruler over My people Israel

verses.original: וָאֶבְחַר֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לִהְי֥וֹת שְׁמִ֖י שָׁ֑ם וָאֶבְחַ֣ר בְּדָוִ֔יד לִהְי֖וֹת עַל־ עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eḇ·ḥar bî·rū·šā·lim lih·yō·wṯ šə·mî šām wā·’eḇ·ḥar bə·ḏā·wîḏ lih·yō·wṯ ‘al- ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: But now I have chosen Jerusalem for My Name to be there and I have chosen David to be over My people Israel

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י עִם־ לְבַ֖ב דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑י לִבְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לְשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ‘im- lə·ḇaḇ dā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇî liḇ·nō·wṯ ba·yiṯ lə·šêm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now it was in the heart of my father David to build a house for the Name of the LORD the God of Israel

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֔י יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָיָה֙ עִם־ לְבָ֣בְךָ֔ לִבְנ֥וֹת בַּ֖יִת לִשְׁמִ֑י הֱ‍ֽטִיב֔וֹתָ כִּ֥י הָיָ֖ה עִם־ לְבָבֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- dā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇî ya·‘an ’ă·šer hā·yāh ‘im- lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā liḇ·nō·wṯ ba·yiṯ liš·mî hĕṭî·ḇō·w·ṯā kî hā·yāh ‘im- lə·ḇā·ḇe·ḵā
verses.literal: But the LORD said to my father David Since it was in your heart to build a house for My Name you have done well to have this . . . in your heart

verses.original: רַ֣ק אַתָּ֔ה לֹ֥א תִבְנֶ֖ה הַבָּ֑יִת כִּ֤י בִנְךָ֙ הַיּוֹצֵ֣א מֵֽחֲלָצֶ֔יךָ הֽוּא־ יִבְנֶ֥ה הַבַּ֖יִת לִשְׁמִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: raq ’at·tāh lō ṯiḇ·neh hab·bā·yiṯ kî ḇin·ḵā hay·yō·w·ṣê mê·ḥă·lā·ṣe·ḵā hū- yiḇ·neh hab·ba·yiṯ liš·mî
verses.literal: Nevertheless you are not the one to build it . . . but your son your own offspring . . . . . . will build the house for My Name

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קֶם יְהוָ֔ה אֶת־ דְּבָר֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּ֑ר וָאָק֡וּם תַּחַת֩ דָּוִ֨יד אָבִ֜י וָאֵשֵׁ֣ב׀ עַל־ כִּסֵּ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כַּאֲשֶׁר֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וָאֶבְנֶ֣ה הַבַּ֔יִת לְשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qem Yah·weh ’eṯ- də·ḇā·rōw ’ă·šer dib·bêr wā·’ā·qūm ta·ḥaṯ dā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇî wā·’ê·šêḇ ‘al- kis·sê yiś·rā·’êl ka·’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh wā·’eḇ·neh hab·ba·yiṯ lə·šêm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now the LORD has fulfilled the word that He spoke I have succeeded . . . my father David and I sit on the throne of Israel as the LORD promised I have built the house for the Name of the LORD the God of Israel

verses.original: וָאָשִׂ֥ים שָׁם֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אָר֔וֹן אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֖ם בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖ת עִם־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ā·śîm šām ’eṯ- hā·’ā·rō·wn ’ă·šer- šām bə·rîṯ Yah·weh ’ă·šer kā·raṯ ‘im- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And there I have placed . . . . . . the ark which contains the covenant of the LORD that He made with the children of Israel

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֗ד לִפְנֵי֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה נֶ֖גֶד כָּל־ קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּפְרֹ֖שׂ כַּפָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ lip̄·nê miz·baḥ Yah·weh ne·ḡeḏ kāl- qə·hal yiś·rā·’êl way·yip̄·rōś kap·pāw
verses.literal: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in front of the whole assembly of Israel and spread out his hands

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עָשָׂ֨ה שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה כִּיּ֣וֹר נְחֹ֗שֶׁת וַֽיִּתְּנֵהוּ֮ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעֲזָרָה֒ חָמֵ֨שׁ אַמּ֜וֹת אָרְכּ֗וֹ וְחָמֵ֤שׁ אַמּוֹת֙ רָחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמּ֥וֹת שָׁל֖וֹשׁ קוֹמָת֑וֹ וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד עָלָ֗יו וַיִּבְרַ֤ךְ עַל־ בִּרְכָּיו֙ נֶ֚גֶד כָּל־ קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּפְרֹ֥שׂ כַּפָּ֖יו הַשָּׁמָֽיְמָה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘ā·śāh šə·lō·mōh kî·yō·wr nə·ḥō·šeṯ way·yit·tə·nê·hū bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·‘ă·zā·rāh ḥā·mêš ’am·mō·wṯ ’ā·rə·kōw wə·ḥā·mêš ’am·mō·wṯ rā·ḥə·bōw wə·’am·mō·wṯ šā·lō·wōš qō·w·mā·ṯōw way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ ‘ā·lāw way·yiḇ·raḵ ‘al- bir·kāw ne·ḡeḏ kāl- qə·hal yiś·rā·’êl way·yip̄·rōś kap·pāw haš·šā·mā·yə·māh
verses.literal: Now Solomon had made a bronze platform five cubits long five cubits wide and three cubits high and had placed it in the middle of the courtyard He stood on it knelt down . . . . . . before the whole assembly of Israel spread out his hands toward heaven

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֗ר יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֵין־ כָּמ֣וֹךָ אֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּבָאָ֑רֶץ שֹׁמֵ֤ר הַבְּרִית֙ וְֽהַחֶ֔סֶד לַעֲבָדֶ֕יךָ הַהֹלְכִ֥ים לְפָנֶ֖יךָ בְּכָל־ לִבָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’ên- kā·mō·w·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hîm baš·šā·ma·yim ū·ḇā·’ā·reṣ šō·mêr hab·bə·rîṯ wə·ha·ḥe·seḏ la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ha·hō·lə·ḵîm lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā bə·ḵāl lib·bām
verses.literal: and said O LORD God of Israel there is no God like You in heaven or on earth keeping Your covenant of loving devotion with Your servants who walk before You with all their hearts

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֗רְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ֙ דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֔י אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ ל֑וֹ וַתְּדַבֵּ֥ר בְּפִ֛יךָ וּבְיָדְךָ֥ מִלֵּ֖אתָ כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer šā·mar·tā lə·‘aḇ·də·ḵā dā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇî ’êṯ ’ă·šer- dib·bar·tā lōw wat·tə·ḏab·bêr bə·p̄î·ḵā ū·ḇə·yā·ḏə·ḵā mil·lê·ṯā kay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: You have kept Your promise to Your servant my father - David What You spoke with Your mouth You have fulfilled with Your hand this day

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֞ה יְהוָ֣ה׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שְׁ֠מֹר לְעַבְדְּךָ֨ דָוִ֤יד אָבִי֙ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֤רְתָּ לּוֹ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹא־ יִכָּרֵ֨ת לְךָ֥ אִישׁ֙ מִלְּפָנַ֔י יוֹשֵׁ֖ב עַל־ כִּסֵּ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֠ק אִם־ יִשְׁמְר֨וּ בָנֶ֜יךָ אֶת־ דַּרְכָּ֗ם לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ בְּת֣וֹרָתִ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלַ֖כְתָּ לְפָנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl šə·mōr lə·‘aḇ·də·ḵā ḏā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇî ’êṯ ’ă·šer dib·bar·tā lōw lê·mōr lō- yik·kā·rêṯ lə·ḵā ’îš mil·lə·p̄ā·nay yō·wō·šêḇ ‘al- kis·sê yiś·rā·’êl raq ’im- yiš·mə·rū ḇā·ne·ḵā ’eṯ- dar·kām lā·le·ḵeṯ bə·ṯō·w·rā·ṯî ka·’ă·šer hā·laḵ·tā lə·p̄ā·nāy
verses.literal: Therefore now O LORD God of Israel keep for Your servant my father David what You promised when You said You will never fail to have a man to sit before Me on the throne of Israel if only your descendants guard their way to walk in My law as you have walked before Me

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יֵֽאָמֵן֙ דְּבָ֣רְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ֥ לְדָוִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl yê·’ā·mên də·ḇā·rə·ḵā ’ă·šer dib·bar·tā lə·‘aḇ·də·ḵā lə·ḏā·wîḏ
verses.literal: And now O LORD God of Israel please confirm . . . what You promised to Your servant David

verses.original: כִּ֚י הַֽאֻמְנָ֔ם יֵשֵׁ֧ב אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־ הָאָדָ֖ם עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ הִ֠נֵּה שָׁמַ֜יִם וּשְׁמֵ֤י הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ לֹ֣א יְכַלְכְּל֔וּךָ אַ֕ף כִּֽי־ הַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנִֽיתִי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ha·’um·nām yê·šêḇ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- hā·’ā·ḏām ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ hin·nêh šā·ma·yim ū·šə·mê haš·šā·ma·yim lō yə·ḵal·kə·lū·ḵā ’ap̄ kî- hab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh ’ă·šer bā·nî·ṯî
verses.literal: But will God indeed dwell with man upon the earth The heavens even the highest heavens . . . cannot contain You much less . . . this temple I have built

verses.original: וּפָנִ֜יתָ אֶל־ תְּפִלַּ֧ת עַבְדְּךָ֛ וְאֶל־ תְּחִנָּת֖וֹ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י לִשְׁמֹ֤עַ אֶל־ הָרִנָּה֙ וְאֶל־ הַתְּפִלָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַבְדְּךָ֖ מִתְפַּלֵּ֥ל לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ā·nî·ṯā ’el- tə·p̄il·laṯ ‘aḇ·də·ḵā wə·’el- tə·ḥin·nā·ṯōw Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāy liš·mō·a‘ ’el- hā·rin·nāh wə·’el- hat·tə·p̄il·lāh ’ă·šer ‘aḇ·də·ḵā miṯ·pal·lêl lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Yet regard the prayer and plea of Your servant O LORD my God so that You may hear . . . the cry . . . and the prayer that Your servant is praying before You

verses.original: לִהְיוֹת֩ עֵינֶ֨יךָ פְתֻח֜וֹת אֶל־ הַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַ֔יְלָה אֶל־ הַ֨מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔רְתָּ לָשׂ֥וּם שִׁמְךָ֖ שָׁ֑ם לִשְׁמ֙וֹעַ֙ אֶל־ הַתְּפִלָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל עַבְדְּךָ֔ אֶל־ הַמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lih·yō·wṯ ‘ê·ne·ḵā p̄ə·ṯu·ḥō·wṯ ’el- hab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh yō·w·mām wā·lay·lāh ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer ’ā·mar·tā lā·śūm šim·ḵā šām liš·mō·w·a‘ ’el- hat·tə·p̄il·lāh ’ă·šer yiṯ·pal·lêl ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: May Your eyes be open toward this temple day and night toward the place where You said You would put Your Name so that You may hear the prayer that Your servant prays toward this place

verses.original: וְשָׁ֨מַעְתָּ֜ אֶל־ תַּחֲנוּנֵ֤י עַבְדְּךָ֙ וְעַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִֽתְפַּֽלְל֖וּ אֶל־ הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְ֠אַתָּה תִּשְׁמַ֞ע מִמְּק֤וֹם שִׁבְתְּךָ֙ מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֖ וְסָלָֽחְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ma‘·tā ’el- ta·ḥă·nū·nê ‘aḇ·də·ḵā wə·‘am·mə·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer yiṯ·pal·lū ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh wə·’at·tāh tiš·ma‘ mim·mə·qō·wm šiḇ·tə·ḵā min- haš·šā·ma·yim wə·šā·ma‘·tā wə·sā·lā·ḥə·tā
verses.literal: Hear the plea of Your servant and of Your people Israel when they pray toward this place May You hear from heaven Your dwelling place May You hear and forgive

verses.original: אִם־ יֶחֱטָ֥א אִישׁ֙ לְרֵעֵ֔הוּ וְנָֽשָׁא־ ב֥וֹ אָלָ֖ה לְהַֽאֲלֹת֑וֹ וּבָ֗א אָלָ֛ה לִפְנֵ֥י מִֽזְבַּחֲךָ֖ בַּבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ye·ḥĕ·ṭā ’îš lə·rê·‘ê·hū wə·nā·šā- ḇōw ’ā·lāh lə·ha·’ă·lō·ṯōw ū·ḇā ’ā·lāh lip̄·nê miz·ba·ḥă·ḵā bab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh
verses.literal: When a man sins against his neighbor and is required to take an oath . . . and he comes to take an oath before Your altar in this temple

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה׀ תִּשְׁמַ֣ע מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וְעָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ וְשָׁפַטְתָּ֣ אֶת־ עֲבָדֶ֔יךָ לְהָשִׁ֣יב לְרָשָׁ֔ע לָתֵ֥ת דַּרְכּ֖וֹ בְּרֹאשׁ֑וֹ וּלְהַצְדִּ֣יק צַדִּ֔יק לָ֥תֶת ל֖וֹ כְּצִדְקָתֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh tiš·ma‘ min- haš·šā·ma·yim wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā wə·šā·p̄aṭ·tā ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā lə·hā·šîḇ lə·rā·šā‘ lā·ṯêṯ dar·kōw bə·rō·šōw ū·lə·haṣ·dîq ṣad·dîq lā·ṯeṯ lōw kə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯōw
verses.literal: then may You hear from heaven and act May You judge Your servants condemning the wicked man by bringing down on his own head what he has done and justifying the righteous man by rewarding him according to his righteousness

verses.original: וְֽאִם־ יִנָּגֵ֞ף עַמְּךָ֧ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לִפְנֵ֥י אוֹיֵ֖ב כִּ֣י יֶֽחֶטְאוּ־ לָ֑ךְ וְשָׁ֙בוּ֙ וְהוֹד֣וּ אֶת־ שְׁמֶ֔ךָ וְהִתְפַּֽלְל֧וּ וְהִֽתְחַנְּנ֛וּ לְפָנֶ֖יךָ בַּבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- yin·nā·ḡêp̄ ‘am·mə·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl lip̄·nê ’ō·w·yêḇ kî ye·ḥeṭ·’ū- lāḵ wə·šā·ḇū wə·hō·w·ḏū ’eṯ- šə·me·ḵā wə·hiṯ·pal·lū wə·hiṯ·ḥan·nə·nū lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā bab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh
verses.literal: When Your people Israel are defeated before an enemy because they have sinned against You and they return to You and confess Your name praying and pleading before You in this temple

verses.original: וְאַתָּה֙ תִּשְׁמַ֣ע מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְסָ֣לַחְתָּ֔ לְחַטַּ֖את עַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַהֲשֵׁיבוֹתָם֙ אֶל־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥תָּה לָהֶ֖ם וְלַאֲבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh tiš·ma‘ min- haš·šā·ma·yim wə·sā·laḥ·tā lə·ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ ‘am·mə·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl wa·hă·šê·ḇō·w·ṯām ’el- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer- nā·ṯat·tāh lā·hem wə·la·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: then may You hear from heaven and forgive the sin of Your people Israel May You restore them to the land You gave to them and their fathers

verses.original: בְּהֵעָצֵ֧ר הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם וְלֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֥ה מָטָ֖ר כִּ֣י יֶֽחֶטְאוּ־ לָ֑ךְ וְהִֽתְפַּלְל֞וּ אֶל־ הַמָּק֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ וְהוֹד֣וּ אֶת־ שְׁמֶ֔ךָ מֵחַטָּאתָ֥ם יְשׁוּב֖וּן כִּ֥י תַעֲנֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·hê·‘ā·ṣêr haš·šā·ma·yim wə·lō- yih·yeh mā·ṭār kî ye·ḥeṭ·’ū- lāḵ wə·hiṯ·pal·lū ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh wə·hō·w·ḏū ’eṯ- šə·me·ḵā mê·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯām yə·šū·ḇūn kî ṯa·‘ă·nêm
verses.literal: When the skies are shut and there is no rain because Your people have sinned against You and they pray toward this place and confess Your name and they turn from their sins because You have afflicted them

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה׀ תִּשְׁמַ֣ע הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וְסָ֨לַחְתָּ֜ לְחַטַּ֤את עֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ וְעַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֥י תוֹרֵ֛ם אֶל־ הַדֶּ֥רֶךְ הַטּוֹבָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵֽלְכוּ־ בָ֑הּ וְנָתַתָּ֤ה מָטָר֙ עַֽל־ אַרְצְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥תָּה לְעַמְּךָ֖ לְנַחֲלָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh tiš·ma‘ haš·šā·ma·yim wə·sā·laḥ·tā lə·ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā wə·‘am·mə·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl kî ṯō·w·rêm ’el- had·de·reḵ haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh ’ă·šer yê·lə·ḵū- ḇāh wə·nā·ṯat·tāh mā·ṭār ‘al- ’ar·ṣə·ḵā ’ă·šer- nā·ṯat·tāh lə·‘am·mə·ḵā lə·na·ḥă·lāh
verses.literal: then may You hear from heaven and forgive the sin of Your servants Your people Israel so that You may teach them . . . the good way in which they should walk May You send rain on the land that You gave Your people as an inheritance

verses.original: רָעָ֞ב כִּֽי־ יִהְיֶ֣ה בָאָ֗רֶץ דֶּ֣בֶר כִּֽי־ יִֽ֠הְיֶה שִׁדָּפ֨וֹן וְיֵרָק֜וֹן אַרְבֶּ֤ה וְחָסִיל֙ כִּ֣י יִהְיֶ֔ה כִּ֧י יָֽצַר־ ל֛וֹ אוֹיְבָ֖יו בְּאֶ֣רֶץ שְׁעָרָ֑יו כָּל־ נֶ֖גַע וְכָֽל־ מַחֲלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: rā·‘āḇ kî- yih·yeh ḇā·’ā·reṣ de·ḇer kî- yih·yeh šid·dā·p̄ō·wn wə·yê·rā·qō·wn ’ar·beh wə·ḥā·sîl kî yih·yeh kî yā·ṣar- lōw ’ō·wy·ḇāw bə·’e·reṣ šə·‘ā·rāw kāl- ne·ḡa‘ wə·ḵāl ma·ḥă·lāh
verses.literal: When famine or plague comes upon the land or blight or mildew or locusts or grasshoppers or when their enemies besiege them in their cities whatever plague or sickness may come

verses.original: כָּל־ תְּפִלָּ֣ה כָל־ תְּחִנָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִהְיֶה֙ לְכָל־ הָ֣אָדָ֔ם וּלְכֹ֖ל עַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵדְע֗וּ אִ֤ישׁ נִגְעוֹ֙ וּמַכְאֹב֔וֹ וּפָרַ֥שׂ כַּפָּ֖יו אֶל־ הַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- tə·p̄il·lāh ḵāl tə·ḥin·nāh ’ă·šer yih·yeh lə·ḵāl hā·’ā·ḏām ū·lə·ḵōl ‘am·mə·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer yê·ḏə·‘ū ’îš niḡ·‘ōw ū·maḵ·’ō·ḇōw ū·p̄ā·raś kap·pāw ’el- hab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh
verses.literal: then may whatever prayer or plea - . . . Your people Israel make each knowing his own afflictions and spreading out his hands toward this temple

verses.original: וְ֠אַתָּה תִּשְׁמַ֨ע מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֜יִם מְכ֤וֹן שִׁבְתֶּ֙ךָ֙ וְסָ֣לַחְתָּ֔ וְנָתַתָּ֤ה לָאִישׁ֙ כְּכָל־ דְּרָכָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר תֵּדַ֖ע אֶת־ לְבָב֑וֹ כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ לְבַדְּךָ֣ יָדַ֔עְתָּ אֶת־ לְבַ֖ב בְּנֵ֥י הָאָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh tiš·ma‘ min- haš·šā·ma·yim mə·ḵō·wn šiḇ·te·ḵā wə·sā·laḥ·tā wə·nā·ṯat·tāh lā·’îš kə·ḵāl- də·rā·ḵāw ’ă·šer tê·ḏa‘ ’eṯ- lə·ḇā·ḇōw kî ’at·tāh lə·ḇad·də·ḵā yā·ḏa‘·tā ’eṯ- lə·ḇaḇ bə·nê hā·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: be heard by You from heaven Your dwelling place And may You forgive and repay each man according to all his ways since You know his heart for You alone know the hearts of men

verses.original: לְמַ֣עַן יִֽירָא֗וּךָ לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ בִּדְרָכֶ֔יךָ כָּל־ הַ֨יָּמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־ הֵ֥ם חַיִּ֖ים עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תָּה לַאֲבֹתֵֽינוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an yî·rā·’ū·ḵā lā·le·ḵeṯ biḏ·rā·ḵe·ḵā kāl- hay·yā·mîm ’ă·šer- hêm ḥay·yîm ‘al- pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tāh la·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: so that they may fear You and walk in Your ways all the days they live in . . . the land that You gave to our fathers

verses.original: וְגַ֣ם אֶל־ הַנָּכְרִ֗י אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹ֥א מֵעַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ הוּא֒ וּבָ֣א׀ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ רְחוֹקָ֗ה לְמַ֨עַן שִׁמְךָ֤ הַגָּדוֹל֙ וְיָדְךָ֣ הַחֲזָקָ֔ה וּֽזְרֽוֹעֲךָ֖ הַנְּטוּיָ֑ה וּבָ֥אוּ וְהִֽתְפַּלְל֖וּ אֶל־ הַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ’el- han·nā·ḵə·rî ’ă·šer lō mê·‘am·mə·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl hū ū·ḇā mê·’e·reṣ rə·ḥō·w·qāh lə·ma·‘an šim·ḵā hag·gā·ḏō·wl wə·yā·ḏə·ḵā ha·ḥă·zā·qāh ū·zə·rō·w·‘ă·ḵā han·nə·ṭū·yāh ū·ḇā·’ū wə·hiṯ·pal·lū ’el- hab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh
verses.literal: And as for the foreigner who is not of Your people Israel . . . but has come from a distant land because of Your great name and Your mighty hand and outstretched arm when he comes and prays toward this temple

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה תִּשְׁמַ֤ע מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ מִמְּכ֣וֹן שִׁבְתֶּ֔ךָ וְעָשִׂ֕יתָ כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִקְרָ֥א אֵלֶ֖יךָ הַנָּכְרִ֑י לְמַ֣עַן יֵדְעוּ֩ כָל־ עַמֵּ֨י הָאָ֜רֶץ אֶת־ שְׁמֶ֗ךָ וּלְיִרְאָ֤ה אֹֽתְךָ֙ כְּעַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלָדַ֕עַת כִּֽי־ שִׁמְךָ֣ נִקְרָ֔א עַל־ הַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנִֽיתִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh tiš·ma‘ min- haš·šā·ma·yim mim·mə·ḵō·wn šiḇ·te·ḵā wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- yiq·rā ’ê·le·ḵā han·nā·ḵə·rî lə·ma·‘an yê·ḏə·‘ū ḵāl ‘am·mê hā·’ā·reṣ ’eṯ- šə·me·ḵā ū·lə·yir·’āh ’ō·ṯə·ḵā kə·‘am·mə·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl wə·lā·ḏa·‘aṯ kî- šim·ḵā niq·rā ‘al- hab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh ’ă·šer bā·nî·ṯî
verses.literal: then may You hear from heaven Your dwelling place and do according to all for which the foreigner calls to You Then all the peoples of the earth will know Your name and fear You as do Your people Israel and they will know that this house I have built is called . . . by Your Name

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יֵצֵ֨א עַמְּךָ֤ לַמִּלְחָמָה֙ עַל־ א֣וֹיְבָ֔יו בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁלָחֵ֑ם וְהִתְפַּֽלְל֣וּ אֵלֶ֗יךָ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הָעִ֤יר הַזֹּאת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַ֣רְתָּ בָּ֔הּ וְהַבַּ֖יִת אֲשֶׁר־ בָּנִ֥יתִי לִשְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yê·ṣê ‘am·mə·ḵā lam·mil·ḥā·māh ‘al- ’ō·wy·ḇāw bad·de·reḵ ’ă·šer tiš·lā·ḥêm wə·hiṯ·pal·lū ’ê·le·ḵā de·reḵ hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ ’ă·šer bā·ḥar·tā bāh wə·hab·ba·yiṯ ’ă·šer- bā·nî·ṯî liš·me·ḵā
verses.literal: When Your people go to war against their enemies wherever You send them and when they pray to You in the direction of this city You have chosen and the house - I have built for Your Name

verses.original: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֙ מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם אֶת־ תְּפִלָּתָ֖ם וְאֶת־ תְּחִנָּתָ֑ם וְעָשִׂ֖יתָ מִשְׁפָּטָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ma‘·tā min- haš·šā·ma·yim ’eṯ- tə·p̄il·lā·ṯām wə·’eṯ- tə·ḥin·nā·ṯām wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā miš·pā·ṭām
verses.literal: then may You hear from heaven . . . their prayer and their plea and may You uphold their cause

verses.original: כִּ֣י יֶחֶטְאוּ־ לָ֗ךְ כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין אָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ יֶחֱטָ֔א וְאָנַפְתָּ֣ בָ֔ם וּנְתַתָּ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י אוֹיֵ֑ב וְשָׁב֧וּם שׁוֹבֵיהֶ֛ם אֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ רְחוֹקָ֖ה א֥וֹ קְרוֹבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ye·ḥeṭ·’ū- lāḵ kî ’ên ’ā·ḏām ’ă·šer lō- ye·ḥĕ·ṭā wə·’ā·nap̄·tā ḇām ū·nə·ṯat·tām lip̄·nê ’ō·w·yêḇ wə·šā·ḇūm šō·w·ḇê·hem ’el- ’e·reṣ rə·ḥō·w·qāh ’ōw qə·rō·w·ḇāh
verses.literal: When they sin against You for there is no one who does not sin and You become angry with them and deliver them to an enemy who takes them as captives to a land far or near

verses.original: וְהֵשִׁ֙יבוּ֙ אֶל־ לְבָבָ֔ם בָּאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבּוּ־ שָׁ֑ם וְשָׁ֣בוּ׀ וְהִֽתְחַנְּנ֣וּ אֵלֶ֗יךָ בְּאֶ֤רֶץ שִׁבְיָם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר חָטָ֥אנוּ הֶעֱוִ֖ינוּ וְרָשָֽׁעְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·šî·ḇū ’el- lə·ḇā·ḇām bā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer niš·bū- šām wə·šā·ḇū wə·hiṯ·ḥan·nə·nū ’ê·le·ḵā bə·’e·reṣ šiḇ·yām lê·mōr ḥā·ṭā·nū he·‘ĕ·wî·nū wə·rā·šā·‘ə·nū
verses.literal: and when they come to their senses in the land to which they were taken . . . and they repent and plead with You in the land of their captors saying We have sinned and done wrong we have acted wickedly

verses.original: וְשָׁ֣בוּ אֵלֶ֗יךָ בְּכָל־ לִבָּם֙ וּבְכָל־ נַפְשָׁ֔ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ שִׁבְיָ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁב֣וּ אֹתָ֑ם וְהִֽתְפַּֽלְל֗וּ דֶּ֤רֶךְ אַרְצָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תָּה לַאֲבוֹתָ֔ם וְהָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַ֔רְתָּ וְלַבַּ֖יִת אֲשֶׁר־ בָּנִ֥יתִי לִשְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ḇū ’ê·le·ḵā bə·ḵāl lib·bām ū·ḇə·ḵāl nap̄·šām bə·’e·reṣ šiḇ·yām ’ă·šer- šā·ḇū ’ō·ṯām wə·hiṯ·pal·lū de·reḵ ’ar·ṣām ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tāh la·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām wə·hā·‘îr ’ă·šer bā·ḥar·tā wə·lab·ba·yiṯ ’ă·šer- bā·nî·ṯî liš·me·ḵā
verses.literal: and when they return to You with all their heart and soul in the land of the enemies who took them captive and when they pray in the direction of the land that You gave to their fathers the city You have chosen and the house I have built for Your Name

verses.original: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֨ מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֜יִם מִמְּכ֣וֹן שִׁבְתְּךָ֗ אֶת־ תְּפִלָּתָם֙ וְאֶת־ תְּחִנֹּ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם וְעָשִׂ֖יתָ מִשְׁפָּטָ֑ם וְסָלַחְתָּ֥ לְעַמְּךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָֽטְאוּ־ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ma‘·tā min- haš·šā·ma·yim mim·mə·ḵō·wn šiḇ·tə·ḵā ’eṯ- tə·p̄il·lā·ṯām wə·’eṯ- tə·ḥin·nō·ṯê·hem wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā miš·pā·ṭām wə·sā·laḥ·tā lə·‘am·mə·ḵā ’ă·šer ḥā·ṭə·’ū- lāḵ
verses.literal: then may You hear from heaven Your dwelling place their prayer and pleas and may You uphold their cause May You forgive Your people who sinned against You

verses.original: עַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֗י יִֽהְיוּ־ נָ֤א עֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ פְּתֻח֔וֹת וְאָזְנֶ֖יךָ קַשֻּׁב֑וֹת לִתְפִלַּ֖ת הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh ’ĕ·lō·hay yih·yū- nā ‘ê·ne·ḵā pə·ṯu·ḥō·wṯ wə·’ā·zə·ne·ḵā qaš·šu·ḇō·wṯ liṯ·p̄il·laṯ ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: Now my God may Your eyes be open and Your ears attentive to the prayer offered in this place

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה קוּמָ֞ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ לְֽנוּחֶ֔ךָ אַתָּ֖ה וַאֲר֣וֹן עֻזֶּ֑ךָ כֹּהֲנֶ֜יךָ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ יִלְבְּשׁ֣וּ תְשׁוּעָ֔ה וַחֲסִידֶ֖יךָ יִשְׂמְח֥וּ בַטּֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh qū·māh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·nū·ḥe·ḵā ’at·tāh wa·’ă·rō·wn ‘uz·ze·ḵā kō·hă·ne·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm yil·bə·šū ṯə·šū·‘āh wa·ḥă·sî·ḏe·ḵā yiś·mə·ḥū ḇaṭ·ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: Now therefore arise O LORD God and enter Your resting place You and the ark of Your might May Your priests O LORD God be clothed with salvation and may Your godly ones rejoice in goodness

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים אַל־ תָּשֵׁ֖ב פְּנֵ֣י מְשִׁיחֶ֑יךָ זָכְרָ֕ה לְחַֽסְדֵ֖י דָּוִ֥יד עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’al- tā·šêḇ pə·nê mə·šî·ḥe·ḵā zā·ḵə·rāh lə·ḥas·ḏê dā·wîḏ ‘aḇ·de·ḵā
verses.literal: O LORD God do not reject . . . Your anointed one Remember Your loving devotion to Your servant David
